parts.name: Access Hole Drills - 15 Series
parts.description: Access hole drill bit for 15 series, .281 x 2.68” bit size.
parts.notes: Bit size .281 is the same as the .281” (7.1mm) hole size of the 15 series Access Hole Drill Jigs on page 12-8, which do not come with a drill bit (the page does not link them explicitly).

parts.name: Anchor Fastener Counterbore Cutters - 15 Series
parts.description: Counterbore cutter for anchor fastener machining on 15 series, 13/16” mill diameter, two flute center cutting.

parts.name: Pipe Cutter
parts.description: Pipe cutter for pipe from .125” (5mm) to .250” (32mm) diameter with .078” (2mm) pipe thickness, as printed.
parts.notes: Badged both F and M. Pipe Diameter copied verbatim; the printed inch and mm figures do not agree with each other (.125” is not 5mm, .250” is not 32mm), so confirm the range with 80/20 before relying on it.

parts.name: Deburring Tool / Blades 5 Pack - Deburring Tool
parts.description: Deburring tool, listed in the same table as the Blades 5 Pack (T-BDEB).
parts.notes: Badged both F and M. The table does not label which row is the tool and which is the blade pack; tool assigned to T-DEBURR from row order and part number.

parts.name: Deburring Tool / Blades 5 Pack - Blades 5 Pack
parts.description: Pack of five blades, listed in the same table as the Deburring Tool (T-DEBURR).
parts.notes: Badged both F and M. Sold as a 5 pack per the title. The table does not label which row is the tool and which is the blade pack; blade pack assigned to T-BDEB from row order and part number.
